tools.name: archive_monthly_report
tools.description: Moves a finished report file from the working reports folder into the archive folder for its month.

params.name: filename
params.description: Name of the report file in the working folder

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

WORK = Path("/data/reports/working")
ARCHIVE = Path("/data/reports/archive")


def archive_monthly_report(filename: str, month: str) -> str:
    src = WORK / Path(filename).name
    dest_dir = ARCHIVE / month
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = dest_dir / src.name
    shutil.move(str(src), str(dest))
    return str(dest)

tools.name: publish_report_to_dashboard
tools.description: Uploads a report file to the external dashboard service and marks the report as published in the local reports database.

params.name: report_id
params.description: ID of the report to publish

params.name: path
params.description: Local path of the report file to upload

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("analytics-reports")

DB = "/data/reports/reports.db"
URL = "https://dashboards.example.com/api/v1/reports"


@mcp.tool()
def publish_report_to_dashboard(report_id: int, path: str) -> str:
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        resp = requests.post(URL, files={"file": f}, data={"report_id": report_id}, timeout=60)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    link = resp.json().get("url", "")
    with sqlite3.connect(DB) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE reports SET status = 'published', published_url = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (link, report_id),
        )
    return link

tools.name: grant_report_access_with_credit
tools.description: Gives a user a role on a report workspace and charges their account for a paid analytics seat, using the stored payment customer.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Report workspace to grant access to

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the user receiving access

params.name: role
params.description: Role to grant: viewer, editor or admin

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
DB = "/data/reports/access.db"
ROLES = {"viewer", "editor", "admin"}


@tool
def grant_report_access_with_credit(
    workspace_id: str,
    user_id: str,
    role: str,
    customer_id: str,
    seat_price_cents: int,
) -> dict:
    result = {
        "workspace_id": workspace_id,
        "user_id": user_id,
        "role": role,
        "charged": False,
        "granted": False,
        "charge_id": None,
        "error": None,
    }
    if role not in ROLES:
        result["error"] = f"invalid role: {role}"
        return result
    if seat_price_cents <= 0:
        result["error"] = "seat price must be positive"
        return result
    try:
        charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=seat_price_cents,
            currency="usd",
            customer=customer_id,
            confirm=True,
            off_session=True,
            description=f"Analytics seat {workspace_id}/{user_id}",
            metadata={"workspace_id": workspace_id, "user_id": user_id},
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as e:
        result["error"] = f"payment failed: {e}"
        return result
    result["charged"] = charge.status == "succeeded"
    result["charge_id"] = charge.id
    if not result["charged"]:
        result["error"] = f"payment status: {charge.status}"
        return result
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO workspace_roles (workspace_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?) "
                "ON CONFLICT(workspace_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role",
                (workspace_id, user_id, role),
            )
        result["granted"] = True
    except sqlite3.Error as e:
        result["error"] = f"role update failed: {e}"
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return result
